### 🟡 Changes recommended Resolve the provider initialization race and retry lifecycle issue, and correct the retry configuration and integration test setup. *Get a fresh assessment by requesting another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview Adds optional periodic OIDC discovery retries and dynamically switches authentication providers when the server becomes available. **Changes:** - Adds retry configuration and documentation. - Updates dynamic authentication and SSH provider routing. - Adds unit and integration test coverage.
File summaries | File | Summary | |---|---| | `integration/auth_oidc_test.go` | Tests startup retry integration flow. | | `hscontrol/types/config.go` | Adds retry configuration. | | `hscontrol/oidc_test.go` | Updates provider setup. | | `hscontrol/oidc_retry_test.go` | Adds retry unit tests. | | `hscontrol/noise.go` | Uses the active provider for SSH authentication. | | `hscontrol/auth.go` | Uses the active provider for registration URLs. | | `hscontrol/app.go` | Implements retry lifecycle and provider switching. | | `docs/ref/oidc.md` | Documents retry configuration. | | `config-example.yaml` | Adds the retry option example. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the new option. |
Review details ### Suppressed comments (1) **integration/auth_oidc_test.go:1991** * The success condition only checks that the login page request returned without an error. The fallback web handler also returns HTTP 200, so this can finish before the retry switches to OIDC and then skip the CLI registration, making the test flaky or falsely exercising the fallback path. Make the condition observe the OIDC switchover or successful node registration before treating login as complete. ``` _, err = doLoginURL(ts.Hostname(), u) assert.NoError(ct, err) ``` - **Files reviewed:** 10/10 changed files - **Comments generated:** 5 - **Review effort level:** Lite
